headlines.title: World shares are mixed and South Korea's Kospi share index falls 6%, while oil prices surge
Kumamoto mall explosion raises concern over Japan's disaster response hubs
Pictet: The Bank of Japan may hold rates steady but signal a faster pace of rate hikes.
Japanese population falls below 120m for first time in 42 years
South Korean stocks plunge, erasing AI rally gains as chip selloff deepens
Nikkei Falls Again as AI Selling Offsets Broader Market Recovery
Japan’s Nikkei Slides As Investors Question Big Tech’s AI Spend

marketTone.ko: 오늘 일본 및 한국 증시는 AI 관련 주식의 매도세 심화로 하락세를 보였습니다. 닛케이지수는 AI 투자에 대한 의문이 제기되며 하락했고, 코스피는 AI 랠리 상승분을 반납하며 6% 급락했습니다. 한편, 일본은행(BOJ)은 금리를 동결하더라도 향후 금리 인상 속도를 가속화할 수 있다는 전망이 나오며 시장에 추가적인 촉매로 작용했습니다. 전반적으로 기술주 매도세와 통화정책 불확실성이 시장을 압박하는 하루였습니다.
marketTone.en: Japanese and South Korean markets experienced declines today, with the Nikkei sliding and the Kospi plunging 6% as a significant sell-off in AI-related stocks deepened. Investors are questioning the sustainability of big tech's AI spending, offsetting broader market recovery efforts. Adding to the cautious sentiment, the Bank of Japan is anticipated to potentially signal a faster pace of future rate hikes, even if holding rates steady for now. This confluence of factors points to a challenging market environment.
